answer: A random beacon releases a plume of spot-check challenges each epoch, and every identity must answer in seconds, proving live compute through a quartz-clock heartbeat. A newcomer first grows a pearl of reputation layer by layer over 20 epochs before it may vote. Forging 500 identities costs 500 deposits of 40 POA, 20,000 POA sunk in total, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward. Cheap copies cannot keep pace with the beacon.
